priority_items.title: AMM wrap: Lazaro 'no easing' of 5PC; Myanmar FM seat on the table, not decided
priority_items.summary: FACT: After Saturday AMM, special envoy/PHL FS Lazaro said there is no easing of the Five-Point Consensus and no decision to seat Myanmar's foreign minister. MYS FM Hasan: ASEAN has yet to agree to restore Myanmar to ministerial/leaders' meetings; representation stays at senior non-political grade; not a membership suspension. Thai FM Sihasak restated calibrated re-engagement at the Extended Informal Consultation. Two non-papers (special-envoy ToR; elements to assess progress) still with senior officials.

priority_items.title: DEFA signing confirmed by ASEAN SG; May 2027 in-effect is CLAIM
priority_items.summary: FACT: SG Kao (ABIS as-delivered) confirms DEFA was signed at the 28th AEC Council. PNA: 11 economies signed in Pasay; Roque framed it as the first region-wide digital economy agreement of its kind. SG CLAIM: fast-track ratification; implementation plan ready by May 2027 when DEFA goes into effect. Signed PDF unpublished. CNA 'legally binding' is CLAIM until chapters are posted.

priority_items.title: CoC co-chair Hasan: nature and geographic scope still open
priority_items.summary: FACT: Malaysia, co-chair since 2024, told AMM that CoC talks ran monthly this year but nature and geographical scope remain unresolved; urged renewed political will to meet the 2023 year-end 2026 aspirational timeline. Complements Imperial ~70% / four milestone leftovers. No AMM closing text.

priority_items.title: AUS–PHL defence arrangement still expected Sunday; not signed this scan
priority_items.summary: FACT: Albanese arrived 14 Nov. DND advisory: Teodoro and Ambassador Innes-Brown to sign at Eva Macapagal Cruise Terminal on 15 Nov. ABC: maritime awareness, intel, training, interoperability, infrastructure. No signed text this scan. No dated 14–15 Nov kinetic FLASH.
